verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no Stagehand pricing (per-task or per-browser-hour) and no documented rate or concurrency limits. Cost-related mentions, such as caching to reduce LLM costs and Browserbase regions, are adjacent features, not transparent pricing or limit documentation. The axis applies to a browser-automation framework with a hosted option, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent per-task or per-browser-hour pricing and documented rate/concurrency limits before committing
